US-Iran talks in Qatar announced, but Tehran denies plans

US President Donald Trump announced that a meeting with Iran would take place in Qatar, with US officials slated to travel to Doha. However, Iran has denied any plans for talks at any level in the coming days. This comes amid reports of a pause in strikes between the two nations, though disagreements persist over the next steps regarding negotiations.
